today.text: It’s quarter to five on Friday. You close the tracker. Then you remember you still owe the team an update.

rule.text: We’d start with one question. When the handoff doesn’t name an owner, what do you do? Flag it and ask the team.

draft.text: We’d build that into the draft. It pulls the counts from the tracker and flags the missing name in the handoff.

review.text: Eighteen closed, two open. That checks out. Who’s taking request 42 on Monday?

sent.text: You add her name and hit send.

reuse.text: Next Friday, drop in the new notes. Your team can run the same check.
